checked_sources: Independent partition-DP over 4856 full-support word/case combinations and analytic refinement argument
correctness.rationale: Proved I_k(w)=qk-C_k(w) by partitioning original symbols among k universal arches and inserting missing symbols, with reverse lower bound from any arch factorization. A full-support word has C_k>=min(n,q+k-1): refine a segment containing a repeated symbol so its symbol contributes to two blocks, increasing coverage at least one until k blocks or n positions. The heavy-first-symbol word a0^(n-q+1)a1..a_(q-1) attains equality. Independent dynamic programming checked full-support layers q=2,3,4 over n up to 8/7/6 with multiple k and found all predicted radii, but all-parameter validity follows from the combinatorial proof.
residual_risks: No unsupported infinite extrapolation from finite replay.
